description: This Java class provides an ExceptionHandler specifically for the root route of a web service. It catches exceptions such as DittoRuntimeException and JsonRuntimeException, logs relevant details, and converts exceptions into appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: RootRouteExceptionHandler
classes.description: Final class providing an ExceptionHandler for the root route, handling exceptions and converting them into HTTP responses.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method returning an ExceptionHandler configured with a function to convert DittoRuntimeException to HttpResponse.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles a DittoRuntimeException by logging and converting it into an HTTP response.

methods.name: logException
methods.description: Logs details about a DittoRuntimeException, including correlation ID and exception class.

methods.name: handleInternalServerError
methods.description: Handles unexpected exceptions by logging and returning a 500 Internal Server Error response.
